inherited_pool.rule: Only exact V2 rights-pass relations/families may be counted; reconstruction must reproduce V2 aggregate identities and counts before action-field access.

all_required: Exact field value is exposed in a provider-native structured field under the frozen gateway.
Exact reuse licence applies to that field/value and is bound by immutable evidence.
The source is the frozen required custodian or carries explicit delegation from that custodian.
Every schema subfield and all-target/exhaustiveness condition for the requirement group is satisfied.
No mapping from metadata relation type to R7 scientific action terminal is inferred.
owner_field_admission_rule.metadata_relation_not_gold: Publication type, RefType, related-article-type, or Crossref relation direction is record/link semantics. It is not scientific action gold, author intent, responsibility, recommendation authority, execution authority, or an exhaustive R7 target algebra.
owner_field_admission_rule.partial: Evidence may be marked PARTIAL_SOURCE_ANALOGUE only; it contributes zero sufficient owner fields.

prohibitions: No case text or action prose
No inferred rights, owner identity, delegation, exhaustiveness, or authority
retention: Retain only protocols, counts, bounded structured token frequency tables, response digests, rights/provenance receipts, field decisions, failure atlas, validators, and checksums. Delete identifiers, raw responses, source CSV, caches, and action-value pairings.
scientific_question: Within the already admitted V2 rights-valid relation pool, do provider-native structured records for retraction, correction/erratum, and expression of concern expose legally reusable, owner-authored, exhaustive semantics sufficient to bind any of the twelve frozen R7 owner-algebra requirement groups?

sources.rights_gate: Exact CC0 repository licence/hash inherited from V2; no mutable head substitution.
Official Europe PMC/EMBL-EBI terms or applicable endpoint licence must explicitly permit reuse; free access alone is insufficient.
Official NLM data/website rights must explicitly cover the exact structured fields; absence or item-specific restrictions are CANNOT_CHECK.
Official NLM copyright/terms evidence required; vocabulary documentation is not instance owner ratification.
Crossref metadata licensing must explicitly cover the exact relation fields; abstracts/full text remain forbidden.

stratum_rules.CORRECTION_OR_ERRATUM: Provider-native exact tokens/relations explicitly denoting correction, corrigendum, or published erratum.
stratum_rules.EXPRESSION_OF_CONCERN: Provider-native exact tokens/relations explicitly denoting expression of concern.
stratum_rules.RETRACTION: Provider-native exact tokens/relations explicitly denoting retraction or retracted-article direction.
